content.comment_body: I am unable to view websites created with [product_name] and uploaded to AWS on Android smartphones. The site appears correctly on iPhones and Windows PCs, but does not display on Android devices. I have tried multiple phones and browsers with no success. Any advice?

I experienced a similar problem with a website hosted on AWS that wouldn't show up on Android devices, though it worked fine on iOS and Windows platforms. After reaching out to an SEO agency, I learned that the cause was certain site elements that weren't compatible with Android browsers. They suggested reviewing CSS and JavaScript compatibility and making sure the site included appropriate meta tags for mobile responsiveness. Implementing these fixes resolved the issue.

Hello everyone, I recently came across a comparable issue with a website hosted on AWS not rendering properly on Android devices, whereas it worked on iOS and Windows. After consulting with a cold calling agency, it was determined that some elements were not fully optimized for Android browsers. They advised checking CSS and JavaScript compatibility and confirming that mobile responsive meta tags were present. This solution not only fixed the visibility issue but also enhanced the user experience overall. For those facing similar concerns, such agencies may offer valuable technical strategies and insights. Hope this is helpful!

analysis.insight_summary: Community members are experiencing trouble accessing websites designed with [product_name] and hosted on AWS from Android devices, although they display correctly on iOS and Windows. The main technical obstacles seem to be related to CSS, JavaScript compatibility, and mobile-responsive meta tags. Users expect web content generated by this tool to be universally accessible, but current issues limit usability for Android users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want websites made with [product_name] to work and display correctly on all prominent mobile operating systems, particularly Android, without any need for system-specific fixes.
